title: Model registry CreateModelVersion for prompts: source must be a placeholder or a non-file URI with a scheme
answers: Why does creating a prompt version or register_prompt return 400 'Invalid prompt source' for my source path?
Which source values can a prompt-tagged model version use on the REST CreateModelVersion endpoint?
Where is local filesystem access for prompt model versions blocked in the server?
Why does a model version get-artifact call serve files from a server-side directory when the source was a bare relative name?
body:
Path: Prompt-tagged CreateModelVersion requests (REST model-version creation, including prompt versions made by register_prompt and create_prompt_version) enter mlflow/server/handlers.py:_create_model_version, which calls mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source on the request source.
Rule: _validate_prompt_source classifies the source with mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme, not urlparse. A non-empty scheme other than file goes through _validate_non_local_source_contains_relative_paths. Any schemeless or file source is accepted only if it exactly equals a value in mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS, otherwise it gets a 400. A schemeless value selects LocalArtifactRepository and becomes the directory that get-artifact serves from, so a separator-free name like 'mlflow' is also unsafe.
Symptom: A prompt version created with a source such as 'mlflow', 'etc', '.', a percent-encoded absolute path, or 'C:/Windows' was stored as the artifact location, and the model-version get-artifact endpoint could then serve files from that local path.
Constraints: Applies only to requests whose prompt tag is effectively true. Regular model versions still go through _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model. An empty source is now rejected for prompt-tagged requests, so callers must send a placeholder. This does not restrict which remote schemes are allowed; ftp:// and similar pass the traversal check.
applies: Server-side validation of CreateModelVersion sources for prompt-tagged model versions in mlflow/server/handlers.py; not client-side artifact handling for regular models.
says: Saving a new prompt version fails with an invalid prompt source error.
Creating prompt versions in the model registry rejects empty or local storage locations.
Downloading artifacts for registered prompts should not expose local files from the server.
Registering a prompt fails when providing a relative file location instead of placeholders.
search: Server-side CreateModelVersion validation for prompt-tagged model versions in mlflow/server/handlers.py:_create_model_version requires sources to be approved placeholders or non-file URIs with schemes via mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source. Sources classified using mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme must match mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS if schemeless or file, or pass _validate_non_local_source_contains_relative_paths for non-empty non-file schemes, else returning a 400. Bare relative names or local file paths previously allowed get-artifact to serve arbitrary files from the server local filesystem. Applies only when the prompt tag is effectively true, empty sources are rejected, regular model versions continue using _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model, and remote schemes like ftp:// are not restricted.
